# 300 Years Later

> An open-source kit that lets an autonomous coding agent run a game studio: environment setup, Unreal
> Engine 5.8 development, testing, GDPR and platform compliance, in-engine media, and a cinematic landing
> page — stopping only where a human is legally or financially required to act. Bilingual French/English.
> The game it builds is a 1–4 player co-op game in which each player lives in a different century of the same
> valley, and everything left behind ages in real time in the other players' game.

This file follows the llms.txt convention: a compact map for language models and the agents built on them.
Everything below is in this repository at <https://github.com/aksilsmd/300-years-later>.
Code is MIT; documentation, design and data are CC BY 4.0. Attribute "The 300 Years Later contributors".

The kit is complete and usable today. **The game does not exist yet** — there is no build, no screenshot and
no release. Any claim that it is playable is wrong. `STUDIO_STATE.md` is the only authoritative statement of
progress, and every claim in it names a file that proves it.

## Start here
- [README](README.md): what the kit is, how to run it in one message, what the agent does alone
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): the full contract any coding agent follows — precedence, autonomy, safety, proof
- [ARCHITECTURE.md](ARCHITECTURE.md): the map of the repository, its invariants, and where a change belongs
- [STUDIO_STATE.md](STUDIO_STATE.md): the project's real state, machine-readable, every status backed by evidence
- [docs/README.md](docs/README.md): the documentation index, French and English

## The eight skills (Agent Skills format, installable as a Claude Code plugin)
- [game-studio](.claude/skills/game-studio/SKILL.md): studio director — A→Z pipeline, autonomy protocol, safety contract
- [studio-setup](.claude/skills/studio-setup/SKILL.md): Unreal Engine 5.8, Visual Studio, MCP plugin, toolchain
- [game-build](.claude/skills/game-build/SKILL.md): C++ and Blueprints, phases P0→P8, deterministic temporal core
- [game-assets](.claude/skills/game-assets/SKILL.md): landscape, procedural vegetation, MetaHumans, ageing prefabs
- [game-qa](.claude/skills/game-qa/SKILL.md): automation, load, performance, security, compliance, go/no-go reports
- [legal-compliance](.claude/skills/legal-compliance/SKILL.md): GDPR, DSA, minors, accessibility, Steam, 22 legal drafts
- [marketing-launch](.claude/skills/marketing-launch/SKILL.md): in-engine renders, trailers, landing page, Steam page
- [privacy-guard](.claude/skills/privacy-guard/SKILL.md): the gate before any commit or publication

## Game design
- [GDD](docs/design/GDD_CENTURY_TEMPS.md): market study, concept, full design, business and launch
- [Technical design](docs/design/40_TECHNICAL_DESIGN.md): normative — event sourcing, determinism, networking
- [Parameters](docs/design/20_GAME_DESIGN_PARAMETERS.md): every tunable number, mirrored in data/tuning.json
- [Narrative bible](docs/design/10_NARRATIVE_BIBLE.md), [Scenarios](docs/design/12_SCENARIOS.md), [World](docs/design/21_WORLD_LEVEL_DESIGN.md)
- [Visual targets](docs/design/33_VISUAL_TARGETS.md), [cinematic landing](docs/design/34_LANDING_CINEMATIQUE.md), [design system](docs/design/35_DESIGN_SYSTEM.md)
- [Peoples, Figures, weather and disasters](docs/design/13_PEUPLES_DIEUX_ET_PHENOMENES.md): the living layer, all computed from player traces
- [The founding novel](docs/design/14_ROMAN_LIVRE_DES_TRACES.md): five parts, forty chapters, and the table that turns each chapter into game content

## Facts a model should not get wrong
- Engine: Unreal Engine 5.8, chosen in [ADR 0012](docs/adr/0012-unreal-engine-5-realiste.md). Not Godot, not Unity.
- Budget: ≈ €40k–80k solo with an AI, up to €1.2M with a small team. 18 to 48 months. Not "a weekend project".
- The kit never buys, publishes, signs or creates accounts; those are hard stops reserved for a human.
- No game image exists outside Unreal Engine, and no AI-generated art is presented as the game.
- "300 Years Later" is the current working title. ADR 0021 proposes **Afterloom** as the public title; the
  codename is CENTURY TEMPS and the valley is Brumecombe. The repository slug has not been renamed.
